'''Valyn Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the daughter of [[Altana Thul|Altana]] and [[Markus Andarius Thul|Markus Thul]]. After her father was captured trying to infiltrate [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], he made a deal with the Republic to send the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|commanding officer]] of [[Havoc Squad]] to retrieve his wife and daughter before defecting. Altana was initially skeptical, but the soldier provided the correct codeword from Markus and the women agreed to slip away. Altana and Valyn reunited with Markus in House Organa before departing [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].
